title: The Devil's Clerk
text: A small devil sits at a desk in the ash, stamping papers with a seal made of a thumb. Queues of the damned wait before it, forever. It runs a claw down a long list and frowns. Your party, it says, is not on its list.

options.label: Bribe the clerk. Every list has room for one more name.

outcomes.text: Your names are on the list now, in red ink, and the way ahead is shorter. You hope never to learn what the list is for.

options.label: The shrewdest forges the paper themselves, thumbprint and all.

outcomes.text: The forgery is perfect, down to the thumbprint.
It spots the forgery at once and rings a little bell. Things come.

options.label: Burn his papers, and see how the damned like their freedom.

outcomes.text: A thousand damned souls go free in the confusion, and you slip out among them. Something below takes notice.
